landing.heroBody: Share a notice, ask a neighbour for help, book the clubhouse, or flag something that needs fixing — all in one friendly app, in the language each resident prefers.
landing.heroNote: Free for societies up to 25 flats. No card needed to start.
landing.trailFooter: Every line carries a name, a flat and a time. Nothing here is anonymous.
landing.problemTitle: A group chat was never built to run a society.
landing.problemLead: Most societies get by on a WhatsApp group, a paper notice board, a booking register and one very patient secretary.
landing.p1Body: Tuesday's notice is 200 messages up by Thursday, and the poll result is lost with it.
landing.p2Body: Ten people reply, no one is responsible, and the same thing is raised again next month.
landing.p3Body: Bookings in one register, residents in a spreadsheet, notices taped near the lift.
landing.featuresTitle: One app. Every corner of society life.
landing.f1Body: Water tank cleaning on Sunday? AGM this Friday? One notice reaches every flat, instantly.
landing.f2Body: Share news, ask a question, reply to each other — a conversation that stays inside your gates.
landing.f3Body: Report a leaking pipe or a broken lift. Track it till the committee marks it resolved.
landing.f4Body: Need sugar, a paediatrician's number, or someone to feed the cat? Ask, and someone answers.
landing.f5Body: Book the clubhouse for Diwali dinner or a morning yoga circle — right from your phone.
landing.f6Body: Every member is approved by your committee. What's shared in Parisar stays in Parisar.
landing.scopeTitle: No gate hardware. No maintenance collection. On purpose.
landing.scopeBody: Parisar is the coordination layer, not a security system or a payment gateway. Fines are recorded so the trail stays complete, but your society's money never moves through the app — collections stay in your own accounts, exactly as they are today.
landing.codeTitle: One code brings the whole society in.
landing.codeBody: We set up your wings, flats and committee on the call. You leave with one society code to share on the group you already have.
landing.codeStep2: We call and set it up
landing.langLine: Parisar works in English, हिन्दी and मराठी. Every resident picks their own.
landing.ctaTitle: Your society could be running on this tonight.
landing.ctaBody: Add your wings and flats, share one code, and invite everyone when you're ready.
landing.footerLine: Parisar — society management for Indian housing societies.
landing.trustIsolation: Your data never leaves your society
landing.featuresLead: From the smallest sugar-borrowing favour to the biggest AGM decision, Parisar keeps every conversation in one warm, well-lit place.
landing.rolesTitle: Friendly for everyone — committee and residents alike.
landing.rolesLead: The committee gets what it needs to run things. Residents get a home screen. Nobody gets a manual.
landing.roleSecBody: Set the society up once, then run it from one screen.
landing.roleSec1: Add wings, flats and committee members
landing.roleSec3: Post notices, run polls, issue flat notices
landing.roleMemBody: Everything a resident needs, one tap from the home screen.
landing.roleMem1: Join with a society code — no forms
landing.roleMem2: Raise a complaint with a photo and follow it
landing.roleMem3: Book the clubhouse and vote in polls
landing.faqQ1: Do residents have to pay to use it?
landing.faqA1: No. The society subscribes; residents never pay anything and never enter payment details. Societies up to 25 flats stay free.
landing.faqQ2: Does Parisar collect maintenance or fines?
landing.faqA2: No. Fines are recorded so the trail stays complete, but money never moves through the app. Your society keeps its own accounts exactly as it does today.
landing.faqQ3: Can another society see our data?
landing.faqA3: No. Every record is locked to your society at the database level, not just hidden in the interface. A member of another society cannot reach it.
landing.faqQ4: What about residents who are not comfortable in English?
landing.faqA4: Every screen works in English, हिन्दी and मराठी, and each resident picks their own — the secretary does not choose for everyone.
landing.faqA5: An evening. Add your wings and flats, invite your committee, and share one code with the group you already have.
landing.demoTitle: This is the app your neighbours will open.
landing.demoBody: One home screen for everything happening in your society today — a notice from the secretary, a poll closing, a clubhouse booking approved, a complaint resolved. Tap through and see for yourself.
landing.demoHint: Try the tabs. And switch the site to हिन्दी or मराठी — the app switches with it.
landing.f7Body: Repaint the lobby? New security agency? Ask the society and watch the count settle.
landing.f8Body: Record a warning, a fine or a notice against a flat — with who issued it, and when.
landing.tourTitle: A quick tour — it really is this simple.
landing.tourBody: See how a resident raises a leaking-pipe complaint, how the committee pushes a maintenance notice, and how a complaint moves from raised to resolved — in about 90 seconds.
landing.tour1: Post a notice in three taps
landing.tour2: Everyone reads it in their own language
landing.tour3: Track every complaint till it is closed
landing.priceTitle: Pick the plan that fits your gate.
landing.priceLead: Start free. Upgrade when your society falls in love with it. Cancel anytime — no lock-ins, no surprises.
landing.priceFoot: Your society pays; residents never do. Parisar never touches your maintenance collections — that money stays in your society's own accounts.
landing.walkLead: The same society, two different jobs. Pick a role and step through what they actually do.
landing.wr1Body: No password to forget. A code arrives by SMS and you're in.
landing.wr2Body: Photograph the leaking pipe, send it, and watch the committee pick it up.
landing.wr3Body: Need a plumber's number or someone to take a parcel? Ask the people upstairs.
landing.wr4Body: Selling a cycle, starting a yoga circle, sharing news — it stays inside your gates.
landing.wr5Body: Pick a date, send the request. The first committee approval locks your slot.
landing.wc1Body: Same one-tap sign-in. Your committee role comes with you.
landing.wc2Body: Set up A-wing, B-wing and every flat once. Residents then join themselves.
landing.wc3Body: Water tanker at 4? AGM on Friday? One notice reaches every flat instantly.
landing.wc4Body: Reply, mark it in progress, close it. Every step carries your name and flat.
landing.wc5Body: Approve new residents and watch your society fill up, flat by flat.
landing.demoAsk: Anyone have a good plumber's number?
